data.title: 塑心 · 音乐会之前
data.description: 她翻到今晚的曲目，指给你看其中一首，说想听听这次的演奏会有什么不同。
data.action: 优雅倚靠着漆黑大提琴箱，修长手指翻阅着今晚的独奏音乐会节目单
data.camera: 中景，节目单与大厅同框
data.promptProse: Virtuosa leans gracefully against her upright glossy cello case in the concert hall foyer, slender fingers browsing a gold-embossed recital program. Behind her, towering marble pillars and deep red velvet drapes reflect warm luminescence from overhead crystal chandeliers across the polished floor.
data.animaCaption: Leaning against her black cello case, she flips through the concert programme booklet and highlights a piece with a slight, expectant tilt of her head.
